attempts.summary: Built a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (MariaDB 10.5.29 + Galera 26.4.22, RHEL9) since no database software existed on the nodes beforehand. Configured wsrep on all nodes (fixing an alphabetical config-include bug where a custom galera-cluster.cnf was silently overridden by the default galera.cnf's wsrep_on=0), opened firewalld ports, bootstrapped the cluster, and loaded an application table (appdb.orders, 4 committed rows, qty_total=42) replicated to all three nodes. Performed the full maintenance-window shutdown (stopped node3, then node2, then node1 last so it retained the highest seqno / safe_to_bootstrap=1), confirmed the cluster was completely down (all three mariadb services inactive), then brought it back (galera_new_cluster on node1, node2 and node3 rejoined via SST) with all committed rows verified present and all three members reporting wsrep_cluster_size=3 / Synced. Additionally ran the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol via systemctl reboot on all three nodes, proving a changed boot_id on each and full cluster/data recovery after each individual restart, never taking down more than one node concurrently during that phase.
